origine_fr: 十, le tout, et 尃, étendre, fait de 甫 sur 寸. Ce qui s'étend partout est grand, vaste. Celui dont le savoir est vaste est érudit.
origine_en: 十, the whole, and 尃, to spread, made of 甫 over 寸. What reaches everywhere is great, wide. Someone whose knowledge is wide is learned.

phrase.en: She has a PhD in history.
